errorState.title: Something went wrong
errorState.description: We couldn't load this information. Please try again.

profile.title: Profile and location
profile.description: Tell us where you are so we can fine-tune the comparison.

province.label: Province
province.help: We use it to estimate traffic risk in your area.

canton.label: Canton
canton.help: Fine-tunes the quote within your province.

hasCurrentInsurance.label: Do you currently have car insurance?
hasCurrentInsurance.help: Helps us understand your situation. It doesn't change this demo's price.

purchaseIntent.label: How soon are you planning to buy?
purchaseIntent.help: Helps us prioritize follow-up. It doesn't change this demo's price.

vehicle.title: Your vehicle
vehicle.description: The vehicle is the factor that weighs the most on price.

year.label: Year
year.help: Newer vehicles are usually more expensive to insure.

make.label: Make
make.help: The make's replacement value affects the premium.

model.label: Model
model.help: We need the exact model to identify the vehicle.

trim.label: Trim
trim.help: The trim determines the equipment and insured value.

ownership.label: Ownership
ownership.help: Some coverages are required depending on how you own the vehicle.

use.label: Main use
use.help: How you use the vehicle changes the estimated risk.

options.commuting: To commute to work or school

annualKm.label: Kilometers driven per year
annualKm.help: Higher mileage means more exposure to risk.

driver.title: You as a driver
driver.description: Your driver profile also affects the price.

birthDate.label: Date of birth
birthDate.help: Age is one of the factors that most affects the price.

licenseYears.label: Years holding a driver's license
licenseYears.help: More driving experience lowers the estimated risk.

claimsLast3Years.label: Claims filed in the last 3 years

errors.birthDate: Enter a valid date (you must be an adult)
errors.licenseYears: Enter a valid number of years
errors.consentAccepted: You must accept the consent to continue

coverage.title: Desired coverage
coverage.description: Pick the protection level you're after. You'll be able to compare all three on the results screen.

level.label: Coverage level
level.help: Determines what's protected. You can change it later from the results.

preferredDeductibleCrc.label: Preferred deductible (optional)
preferredDeductibleCrc.help: A higher deductible usually lowers the monthly premium.

errors.preferredDeductibleCrc: Enter a valid amount in colones

liability.name: Third-party liability
liability.description: Basic legally required coverage for damage to third parties.

extended.name: Extended
extended.description: Third-party liability plus theft, fire, and natural disasters.

full.name: Full coverage
full.description: The most complete coverage, includes own-damage collision.
